candidate_reports.remark: Indian Springs ASOS reported a 59 mph wind gust from a nearby thunderstorm.
2 mesquite trees snapped in half on Boulder Highway and West Russell Road from a nearby thunderstorm.
Gust to 58 mph measured at the Clark County Wetlands from a nearby thunderstorm. Data courtesy of Earth Networks.
Barstow Daggett Airport gusted to 64 mph from a nearby thunderstorm.
Photo shows roof damage from thunderstorm winds in Meadview_ AZ.
KDAG gusted to 59 mph at 1540 PM_ peak gust of 89 MPH at 1542 PM.
Social media photos show water flowing across Fort Irwin Rd at I-15 with cars stuck in water.
Images taken by Mojave National Park Service personnel show mud and debris covering Cima Rd just south of Interstate 15. Debris is estimated to be 1 to 2 feet deep. Time is estimated based on radar.
Powerlines down over Amboy Road due to thunderstorm winds. Reported via social media. Time estimated by radar.
Kingman Airport (KIGM) recorded 60+ mph gusts from 0811-0824.
Corrects previous flash flood report from 6 ENE New Kingman-Butler. Images and videos show flash flooding along Route 66 between Kingman Airport and Valle Vista. Time is estimated based on radar.
Photo of flood control sensor shows damage due to thunderstorm winds.
KLSV reported a peak wind of 71 MPH.
Corrects previous tstm wnd gst report from Cottonwood Cove. Cottonwood Cove HADS sensor reports peak wind of 81 MPH.
Semi-truck blown over due to thunderstorm winds.
Images and videos show flash flooding along Route 66 between Kingman Airport and Valle Vista. Time is estimated based on radar.
AWOS station KHII Lake Havasu City Airport.
Cottonwood Cove HADS sensor reports peak wind of 81 MPH.
Emergency management reports capsized boats and water rescues on Lake Havasu.
Semi-truck blown off I-40 near MM 40 due to high winds.
Mesonet station BDCNV Us-95 Mm 53.
Highway 95 is closed in both directions due to flooding.
Webcam shows significant flooding in Short Creek covering the Hilldale Bridge. Water reached the bridge at 0925 and covered the bridge at 0940.
Lincoln County Sheriff reports flooding in northern Caliente. Photos show water flowing over the road and into the Meadow Valley Wash.
Video shows water flowing over Nevada State Route 317.
Photo shows water flowing over Highway 165 near Nelson.
NV DOT reports flooding blocking both lanes of State Route 165 resulting in the closure of the road.
Public reports flooding near Mile Marker 20 of Highway 319 in Lincoln County.
Video shows water flowing over Stockton Hill Road with the shoulder on the right hand side of the road having been washed out.
Webcam shows multiple feet of water flowing across Pierce Ferry Road at the Archibald Wash.
Local law enforcement reports multiple feet of water flowing over Route 66 near mile marker 65. Emergency manager reports two swift water rescues due to this flooding.
Photo shows an SUV buried to the front bumper by mud and debris from flooding.
Video shows water running across Sandy Point Drive in Meadview_ AZ.
Stockton Hill Road is closed due to flooding from Pierce Ferry road to Mile Post 30.
Antares Road is closed due to flooding between Pierce Ferry Road and Highway 66.
Pierce Ferry Road is closed due to flooding from Mile Post 9 to Stockton Hill Road.
Photo shows power pole down across Kingston Road.
Corrects previous tstm wnd dmg report from 21 NNW Mountain Pass. Photo shows power pole down across Kingston Road.
California Highway Patrol reports a semi rollover due to wind.
California Highway Patrol reports another semi rollover due to wind.
Single gust of 62 mph out of the SSE.
One inch hail reported in Havasu Heights. Time estimated by radar.
Ram Peak station on the Mohave County Flood Control District ALERT system. The period of the rain event was 43 minutes.
Catsaurus station on the Mohave County Flood Control District ALERT System. The period of the rain event was 45 minutes.
One inch hail reported at Kershaw-Ryan State Park.
All lanes blocked on State Route 319 due to flash flooding.
